name: Orbit
header:
<?xml version="1.0"?>
<VTKFile type="ImageData" version="0.1" byte_order="LittleEndian" compressor="vtkZLibDataCompressor">
  <RD format_version="3">
    <description>
                                                      This is a test of an rd that uses an iteration step implemented to treat reagents a and b as a complex number (a+bi) and raising it to a power.;
[link]</a>
    </description>
    <rule name="Orbit" type="formula" wrap="1" neighborhood_type="vertex" neighborhood_range="1" neighborhood_weight="laplacian">
      <param name="timestep">
        0.05
      </param>
      <param name="clampMin">
        -1
      </param>
      <param name="clampMax">
        1
      </param>
      <param name="constReal">
        0
      </param>
      <param name="constImag">
        0
      </param>
      <param name="realPower">
        1
      </param>
      <param name="imagPower">
        -1
      </param>
      <param name="D_a">
        0.4
      </param>
      <param name="D_b">
        0.1
      </param>
      <param name="mag_amp">
        1
      </param>
      <param name="mag_power">
        2
      </param>
      <param name="mag_zeroPt">
        0
      </param>
      <formula number_of_chemicals="4">
                        c = pow(a*a + b*b, mag_power) * mag_amp + mag_zeroPt;
d = atan2( b, a );
delta_a = clamp( timestep * pow( c, realPower) * pow( 2.718281828459045235360287471352f, -imagPower*d ) * cos( imagPower * log( c ) + realPower * d ) + D_a * laplacian_a + constReal, clampMin, clampMax );
delta_b = clamp( timestep * pow( c, realPower) * pow( 2.718281828459045235360287471352f, -imagPower*d ) * sin( imagPower * log( c ) + realPower * d ) + D_b * laplacian_b + constImag, clampMin, clampMax );
      </formula>
      
    </rule>
    <initial_pattern_generator apply_when_loading="false">
      <overlay chemical="a">
        <overwrite>
          
        </overwrite>
        <white_noise low="-0.1" high="0.1">
          
        </white_noise>
        <everywhere>
          
        </everywhere>
        
      </overlay>
      <overlay chemical="b">
        <overwrite>
          
        </overwrite>
        <white_noise low="-0.1" high="0.1">
          
        </white_noise>
        <everywhere>
          
        </everywhere>
        
      </overlay>
      
    </initial_pattern_generator>
    <render_settings>
      <surface_color r="1" g="1" b="1">
        
      </surface_color>
      <color_low r="0" g="0" b="0">
        
      </color_low>
      <color_high r="1" g="1" b="1">
        
      </color_high>
      <show_color_scale value="false">
        
      </show_color_scale>
      <show_multiple_chemicals value="false">
        
      </show_multiple_chemicals>
      <active_chemical value="a">
        
      </active_chemical>
      <low value="-2">
        
      </low>
      <high value="2">
        
      </high>
      <vertical_scale_1D value="30">
        
      </vertical_scale_1D>
      <vertical_scale_2D value="30">
        
      </vertical_scale_2D>
      <contour_level value="0">
        
      </contour_level>
      <use_wireframe value="false">
        
      </use_wireframe>
      <show_cell_edges value="false">
        
      </show_cell_edges>
      <show_bounding_box value="true">
        
      </show_bounding_box>
      <slice_3D value="true">
        
      </slice_3D>
      <slice_3D_axis value="z">
        
      </slice_3D_axis>
      <slice_3D_position value="0.5">

      <show_displacement_mapped_surface value="false">

  </RD>
